scripts.test: pnpm --filter @courseweave/lab test && pnpm --filter @courseweave/learn test && pnpm --filter @courseweave/author test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @courseweave/lab run build && pnpm --filter @courseweave/learn run build && pnpm --filter @courseweave/author run build
scripts.test:e2e:installed-wheel: COURSEWEAVE_INSTALLED_WHEEL=1 pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:author: pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.author.config.ts
